{{Top|leg}}
'''Reefstone''' was a type of fossilized rock. During the last [[Standard century/Legends|century]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], many lower-caste [[Kon'me]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bal'demnic/Legends|Bal'demnic]] lived in huts that were built from reefstone.
